message.content: {"caption":"Trace-based workflow for turning agent outcomes into an evolved reusable skill.","description":"A left-to-right process diagram shows rollout using existing skills producing one successful trace and two error traces. Separate analysts process the traces in parallel and propose skill patches: additions based on the success and error traces, and an edit that deepens existing rules from an error trace. Arrows lead from the patches to a merge step, which produces an evolved skill.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
